resources.string: Find any movie or series. If it is not here yet, request it and it downloads automatically.
Requests are not set up on this server yet.
Features other media servers need plugins for, built in. Switch off what you do not want.
This account is not allowed to do that.
Enter the code from your authenticator app.
The other app did not answer or rejected the request.
Enter the address of your Streamero server, for example https://media.example.com.
TMDb API key or Read Access Token
Create a free account at themoviedb.org, request an API key under Settings → API, and paste the Read Access Token here.
Bazarr is not connected yet. An administrator can add it under Requests.
Bazarr is fetching the missing languages.
Downloaded. It appears on this title in a moment.
Add a library under Me → Libraries and your films and series will appear here.
Your server has no films or series for you yet.
Type with the keyboard on the left. Results appear here as you type.
On your phone or computer where you are already signed in to Streamero, open Settings → Quick Connect and enter this code. This TV signs in by itself.
The code expired. Ask for a new one.
Signing in on a TV or another new device? Enter the 6-digit code it shows to sign it in as you.
That code is unknown or has expired.
Server administration is available on the web and in the phone app.
No browser is installed to sign in with.
The sign-in expired or was already used. Try again.
The sign-in provider refused the sign-in.
No account on this server is linked to that sign-in. Ask the administrator.
This account is not allowed to sign in to this server.
Single sign-on is not set up completely on the server.
Password sign-in is turned off on this server.
Watch in sync with others: play, pause and seek apply to everybody in the group.
That is not a valid invite link.
No groups right now. Start one from a film or an episode.
Nothing is playing in this group yet.
Send this link to the people you want to watch with. They need an account on this server.
You are no longer in the watch-together group.
This download is no longer on the device.
Keeps the next unwatched episodes on this device. Watched ones are removed when the app syncs.
Nothing downloaded yet. Use Download on a film or an episode to watch it without a connection.
Remove all downloaded films and episodes from this device?
The server cannot be reached. Your downloads still play.
This title is above the age limit of the profile.
No channels yet. An administrator adds tuners in the web app under Settings → Live TV.
No favourite channels yet. Tap the star next to a channel.
Series recording set up: new episodes will be recorded.
All tuners are in use. Try again when a recording or another viewer has finished.
This format is read in the web app. Your progress there is shown here.
This device could not play the file directly, so the server is converting it.
This video cannot be played on this device.
Remove “%1$s” from Continue watching? The saved position is forgotten.
Delete the library “%1$s”? The files stay on disk; titles, progress and artwork of this library are removed from the server.
Delete the user @%1$s? Their profiles, progress and sessions are removed.
Delete this invite? Its link stops working.
Delete the API key “%1$s”? Apps using it lose access.
Title and synopsis over the picture a few seconds into a pause.
Long-press a title in Continue watching to remove it.
Phones and tablets: a playing video continues in a small window when you leave the app.
Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
Too many failed sign-ins. The account is locked for 15 minutes.
Too many attempts from your network. Wait a moment and try again.
Not found. It may have been removed already.
Please check the entered values (passwords need at least 8 characters).
Usernames may contain letters, digits, spaces and . _ - @
The last administrator cannot be removed, demoted or disabled.
You cannot delete or disable your own account.
This action is not available with an API key.
The code is not correct or was already used.
Too many wrong PINs. Try again in a few minutes.
Not available in a kids profile.
That folder does not exist or is outside the media folders.
TMDb rejected this key. Copy it again from themoviedb.org/settings/api.
TMDb could not be reached from the server. Try again later.
This file needs transcoding, which your account is not allowed to use.
The server could not prepare this file for playback.
The server is converting as many videos as it can. Try again in a moment.
This item has no playable file.
This file is no longer where the server expected it. The library is being rescanned; try again in a minute.
The channel cannot be tuned right now.
That e-mail address is not valid.
That file is not a JPEG, PNG or GIF picture.
The picture is larger than 8 MB.
That address is not valid (use http:// or https://).
An account can have at most 6 profiles.
No authenticator app on this device. Scan the QR code or enter the key by hand.
This backup was made by a newer Streamero version. Update the server first.
The file is not a readable Streamero backup.
Another backup or restore is running. Try again in a moment.
Type the backup name exactly to confirm.
Link an administrator to single sign-on or LDAP first, or you could lock everyone out.
This account signs in through single sign-on or LDAP and has no Streamero password.
Profiles let several people share this account (up to 6). A kids profile cannot open settings; leaving it needs the account password.
4–6 digits. Leave empty to keep the current PIN.
Devices signed in to your account. Signing a device out takes effect immediately.
Devices signed in to this server, for all users. Signing a device out takes effect immediately.
Sign out “%1$s”? It will have to sign in again.
Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden…) in addition to your password.
Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or on this phone tap the link. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
QR code for the authenticator app
Sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app. To turn it off, confirm your password.
Each code can be used once instead of an app code, e.g. if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again. Other devices were signed out.
Paste the invite link you were sent. It already says which server it is for.
That is not an invite link.
Paste the whole link: it says which server the invite is for.
This invite link has expired, was used up or was revoked. Ask for a new one.
You were invited. Choose a username and password for your account.
Send server events to Discord, ntfy, Gotify or any webhook: new titles, who started watching, sign-ins.
Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy URL.
The full topic URL; add an access token for protected topics.
Server address; the app token comes from Gotify → Apps.
Receives a JSON POST: event, title, message, data, server.
Remove “%1$s”? It is deleted when you save.
A backup holds the whole database (users, libraries, watch history, settings) and the config folder. Media files are never included.
A library scan is running. The backup stays consistent, but titles still being added may be missing from it.
Delete this backup file? This cannot be undone.

Everything in the database is replaced with this backup: users, libraries, watch history and settings made after it are lost. A safety backup of the current state is written first, then the server restarts.
Restoring %1$s… The server restarts when it is done.
The state before the restore is kept as %1$s.
The worker writes one backup a day.
How many scheduled and manual backups to keep (1–100). Uploaded and pre-restore backups are only deleted by hand.
Downloaded posters and backdrops can be fetched again, so they are left out by default. Including them makes backups much larger.
Where channels come from: an M3U playlist from your provider, or an HDHomeRun on your network. The tuner count limits how many channels play or record at once.
A path the server can read, inside the media folders or /config/livetv.
IP address or URL of the HDHomeRun, e.g. http://192.168.1.50
Streams your provider allows at once (0 = unlimited).
Empty = as many as the device has.
Only if your provider asks for a specific one.
No HDHomeRun found. With Docker bridge networking the search cannot see the LAN: add the device by its address.
Remove “%1$s” and its channels? Scheduled recordings on them are cancelled.
Programme listings in XMLTV format. Refreshed on a schedule; unchanged programmes are skipped.
Only for times without an offset. Empty = UTC.
Matching channels to the guide by hand, and the recording and time-shift settings, are on the web.
Let people sign in with your identity provider (OpenID Connect) or directory (LDAP / Active Directory).
The address people open Streamero at. Single sign-on redirects back here, so it must match exactly.
Only single sign-on and LDAP accounts can sign in. Needs an administrator who can already sign in that way.
Recovery mode is on (STREAMERO_PASSWORD_LOGIN_RECOVERY): administrators can sign in with a password. Remove it once you are back in.
Works with Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, Microsoft Entra ID, Google and any provider with OpenID Connect discovery.
Set the public address above to get the redirect URI.
Remove %1$s? Accounts linked through it will no longer be able to use it.
Shown as “Continue with …” on the sign-in page.
Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Part of the redirect URI; cannot be changed later.
Stored on the server and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the current one.
Separated by spaces; openid is always included.
A dotted path works too, e.g. realm_access.roles.
Members become administrators; others lose admin rights. Empty: managed in Streamero.
Only members may sign in. Empty: everyone the provider signs in.
A first sign-in creates a Streamero user. Otherwise only linked users can sign in.
An existing user with the same e-mail address is linked on first sign-in, if the provider says the address is verified.
For providers that do not send email_verified (e.g. Microsoft). Only for a provider you control.
The provider answered correctly (%1$d signing keys).
It does not advertise PKCE (S256); Streamero sends it anyway.
Directory users sign in with their username and password in the normal fields, on the web, in the apps and in third-party apps. Their password is never stored.
Usernames that are not Streamero accounts are looked up in the directory; an account is created on first sign-in.
Encrypt ldap:// connections. Not needed for ldaps://.
Unsafe: anyone on the network could read passwords. For testing only.
Without StartTLS or ldaps:// passwords travel unencrypted.
uid, or sAMAccountName for Active Directory.
Search groups instead of reading memberOf, e.g. (&(objectClass=groupOfNames)(member={dn})).
Group DN whose members are administrators. Empty: managed in Streamero.
Group DN required to sign in. Empty: anyone the filter finds.
Connected and signed in with the service account.
